description: List all Japanese national holidays and substitute holidays for a year, based on the National Holidays Act and verified against the Cabinet Office CSV. Each holiday has `name` (descriptive) and `official_name` (as written by the Cabinet Office). flags: `estimated`/`unverified` when the year's holidays are an estimate (tell the user). / その年の国民の祝日・休日（振替休日・国民の休日を含む）の一覧を返します。name は内容がわかる名前、official_name は内閣府の表記です。その年の祝日が見込みのときは、flags に estimated・unverified が付きます（利用者に伝えてください）。
name: list_holidays
title: List Japanese national holidays / 日本の祝日の一覧
